body: You own C63. U20 (Cursor, merged) specified real-time damage in full and priced it PER FIGHT-SECOND, so C62's 20 Hz answer cannot invalidate it. You build the damage math as a pure module the core will call - Claude is on the core (R82) against FightSimulation.gd, so neither of us touches the other's file. Read research/U20_DAMAGE_IN_REAL_TIME.md as your spec; TASK_C63.md is self-contained. Three traps: no tick and no Hz anywhere, refuse an unknown region or contact word rather than defaulting it, and expose balance numbers as named consts with U20's reasoning rather than burying them in expressions - you are not the one deciding balance. Suite reads 194/0.
